report.markdown:
# Length of the Nile and Amazon

## Main Findings

Most major reference sources still consider the Nile to be the world's longest river rather than the Amazon. [1][2] One source reports that geography textbooks have called the Nile the world's longest river for over a century with a traditional length of 6,650 km. [2]

## Sources

1. [https://iere.org/which-river-is-longer-nile-or-amazon](https://iere.org/which-river-is-longer-nile-or-amazon) — iere.org, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [Is the Nile Longer Than the Amazon? The Surprising Geographic Debate | Geography Worlds](https://geographyworlds.com/blog/is-the-nile-longer-than-the-amazon) — geographyworlds.com, published 2026-03-30, fetched 2026-10-31
